tasks.title: Promote and validate the staged pending_prompt migration
tasks.dod: The staged 01_create_pending_prompt migration is promoted into the live migrations/ tree, applies and reverts cleanly (migrate:up then migrate:down) against a fresh SQLite DB.

tasks.title: Add the PendingPromptRepository port interface
tasks.dod: A new PendingPromptRepository interface (savePendingPrompt/findPendingPrompt/clearPendingPrompt) compiles and is exported from src/app/ports, with no implementation yet.

tasks.title: Implement PendingPromptRepository against SQLite
tasks.dod: Unit/integration tests for save/find/clear against a tmpdir SQLite DB pass, including the upsert-on-id=1 and delete-means-absent semantics from data-model.md.

tasks.title: Make Scheduler.tick() a public awaitable entry point; stop() awaits an in-flight tick
tasks.dod: Unit tests confirm tick() is callable externally and returns a Promise that resolves after fire+expire complete, and that stop() called mid-tick resolves only after the in-flight tick finishes (no setInterval remains, per ADR-0001).

tasks.title: Add idempotent-retry tests for FireDueReminders
tasks.dod: A test that calls tick() twice against the same due reminder (simulating a retried wake call) asserts exactly one send/mark-fired occurs, and a test confirms a reminder left in `firing` after a failed send is not silently re-sent successfully twice.

tasks.title: Characterize today's router dispatch + auth behavior before the gate refactor
tasks.dod: Tests pin current behavior for every handleUpdate path (forwarded message, pending custom-time text, /list, /settings, callback_query) including the pre-existing gap that only callback_query checks the sender — this is the regression safety net called out in sad.md §11 before router.ts is touched.

tasks.title: Centralize Owner authorization in a single router-dispatch gate (ADR-0003)
tasks.dod: A single isOwner() check runs once in buildRouter's handleUpdate before any handler dispatch; new tests show every handler (not only callback_query) denies a non-Owner sender with no side effect, and the T6 characterization tests for Owner-sender behavior still pass unchanged.

tasks.title: Replace the in-memory pendingCustom map with the durable PendingPromptRepository
tasks.dod: handleQuickPick's/handleSnoozePick's custom branch and handleCustomTimeInput read/write/clear pending_prompt via the repository instead of the module-level Map; a test simulating a process restart (new repo instance, same DB) shows a pending prompt set before restart is still recognized after.

tasks.title: Add a wake-interval-aware delay estimate to reminder confirmation (AC-03)
tasks.dod: ScheduleReminder (or the router confirmation reply) compares the chosen time to the configured wake interval and a test confirms the Owner is told delivery may arrive up to one wake interval late when the chosen time is sooner than that interval, and sees no such note otherwise.

tasks.title: Build the node:http server skeleton with route dispatch (ADR-0002)
tasks.dod: A node:http server routes POST /webhook/telegram and POST /wake to injected handlers and returns 404 for any other path/method; a test hits an unknown route and gets 404 with no handler invoked.

tasks.title: Implement the Telegram webhook handler (secretToken verification)
tasks.dod: A request with a missing/invalid X-Telegram-Bot-Api-Secret-Token is rejected 401 per contracts/openapi.yaml with no handler invoked (AC-04); a valid request is forwarded to the Owner-gated router and always returns 200 regardless of the sender's Owner status (AC-04b), matching the contract's Ack schema.

tasks.title: Implement the wake handler (constant-time bearer token verification)
tasks.dod: A request with a missing/invalid bearer token is rejected 401 per contracts/openapi.yaml with scheduler.tick() never invoked (AC-04); a valid request invokes tick() and the response is not sent until tick() resolves (AC-01b), returning the Ack schema on success.

tasks.title: Wire the HTTP adapter into the composition root; switch to webhook mode; graceful shutdown
tasks.dod: main.ts starts the http server instead of bot.start()/long-polling and calls bot.api.setWebhook with the secret token; the setInterval scheduler.start() call is removed (ADR-0001); SIGTERM/SIGINT handlers await scheduler.stop() before db.close(); fly.toml declares an http_service block so Fly.io can track inbound activity for idle-stop.

tasks.title: Integration tests for the new public perimeter and catch-up semantics
tasks.dod: End-to-end tests over the running http server show: unauthenticated webhook/wake requests are rejected 100% with no Owner data changed (AC-04); a pending prompt persisted before a simulated restart is honored after (AC-05); reminders that became due during a simulated wake-cycle gap all fire once tick() next runs, none lost (AC-07).

tasks.title: Document the webhook + wake deployment setup
tasks.dod: A deployment note lists the new required env vars (webhook secret token, wake bearer token, port), the one-time setWebhook step, and the configured wake interval/cadence for the external scheduler, so a redeploy from scratch is reproducible.
